description: This file defines the class SugarWidgetFieldVarchar, which extends SugarWidgetReportField and provides methods for constructing SQL query filters and input display for varchar fields in reports within the SuiteCRM system.

classes.name: SugarWidgetFieldVarchar
classes.description: A widget class for handling varchar field report filters and input display in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the widget with a layout manager.

methods.name: queryFilterEquals
methods.description: Constructs a SQL filter for equality comparison.

methods.name: queryFilterNot_Equals_Str
methods.description: Constructs a SQL filter for inequality comparison.

methods.name: queryFilterContains
methods.description: Constructs a SQL filter to check if a field contains a substring.

methods.name: queryFilterdoes_not_contain
methods.description: Constructs a SQL filter to check if a field does not contain a substring.

methods.name: queryFilterStarts_With
methods.description: Constructs a SQL filter to find fields starting with a specific string.

methods.name: queryFilterEnds_With
methods.description: Constructs a SQL filter to find fields ending with a specific string.

methods.name: queryFilterone_of
methods.description: Constructs a SQL filter to match one of several values.

methods.name: displayInput
methods.description: Returns HTML for a text input element for report filters.
